command: tell application "System Events" to tell process "StackOS"
set allElements to entire contents of window 1
set itemElement to contents of itemRef
set r to role of itemElement
if r is "AXWebArea" then set webAreas to webAreas + 1
set t to value of itemElement

if {"Overview", "Backups", "Home", "StackOS", "Local service", "Running", "Your local runtime and projects", "Accounts", "App", "Attention", "Work", "Activity"} contains t then set end of observedText to t
